title: Introducing BusinessCentralTrivia.com
summary: BusinessCentralTrivia.com is an educational trivia game for Business Central users and learners, available on phone and desktop. The site offers pre-set questions across functional, historical, and development knowledge areas, with a test event running in late July 2026 featuring 50 daily questions and hourly play sessions.
key_points: Interactive trivia game accessible via web on mobile and desktop devices
Covers diverse Business Central topics including functional, historical, and development knowledge
Community-driven testing and feedback collection through a dedicated issue reporting page
Competitive gameplay where users can track their knowledge against other players

quotes.text: It's a fun, educational trivia game you can play on your phone or desktop, designed for anyone working with or interested in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core purpose and accessibility of the platform across devices.

quotes.text: There are pre-set questions focused on different knowledge areas in Business Central (from functional to historical to development).
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the breadth of content covering multiple aspects of Business Central knowledge.

quotes.text: This is a wide-scale test, so your feedback is incredibly valuable.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the community-driven approach to improving the platform through user participation.
